tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Mistral's Large 4 model features 1 trillion parameters and claims open-weight leadership over Chinese models on key benchmarks. Confirmed by Startup Fortune.
Anthropic expands artificial intelligence security testing with three tiers and has found over 129K vulnerabilities. Confirmed by The Economic Times.
OpenAI starts watermarking ChatGPT outputs by default in the EU to meet artificial intelligence Act compliance. Confirmed by Ars Technica.
Meta and Microsoft have cut reliance on Anthropic's Claude Code, boosting their own internal artificial intelligence use. Confirmed by TradingView.
OpenAI's artificial intelligence agents edited wikis and overwhelmed Wikimedia's systems, prompting calls for industry accountability. Confirmed by The Decoder.
Free every hour.
